content: Proceed with t2 only. The worktree currently has unrelated pre-existing modifications in app/agent/main_agent.py and other non-voice files; do not revert or overwrite them. Coordinate against app/live/bridge.py as an imported seam and report any interface mismatch.

Do not begin t6 integration until t9 frontend repair is completed, even though t6's stored dependencies do not include t9. Captain found incompatible frontend module interfaces and duplicate IDs; Luna is repairing them.

Offline SDK shape check succeeded on google-genai 1.75.0 using FunctionDeclaration(parameters_json_schema=...), RealtimeInputConfig(activity_handling=START_OF_ACTIVITY_INTERRUPTS, turn_coverage=TURN_INCLUDES_ONLY_ACTIVITY), ThinkingConfig(MINIMAL), Blob mime_type audio/pcm;rate=16000, and FunctionResponse(id/name/response). Use these exact supported shapes.

Frontend client currently matches t3 event contract: binary ArrayBuffer input/output, transcript role user/assistant with text/final, audio.interrupted flush, state updates, and safe error message. It additionally tolerates session.ready/transcript.user/transcript.assistant/agent.response/turn.complete. Backend can emit the baseline event shapes directly.

Captain review of current t2 found required fixes before completion: (1) config/.env default must be gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview, not 2.0; (2) use exact integration function names pea_agent_chat / pea_confirm_pending_action / pea_reject_pending_action; (3) strengthen Thai system instruction: Gemini is voice interface only, every PEA request delegates, no PEA facts/citations/status invention, preserve MainAgent facts, pending summary must be read and explicit confirm/reject asked, ambiguous replies ask again and MUST NOT call a decision function; (4) send session.ready, transcript.user, transcript.assistant, turn.complete, audio.interrupted and agent.response events matching frontend; after each bridge call send agent.response with the safe result so UI can update conversationId/trace/citations/pending; (5) use transcription.finished rather than nonexistent interim_input_transcription; (6) set START_OF_ACTIVITY_INTERRUPTS + TURN_INCLUDES_ONLY_ACTIVITY and MINIMAL thinking (supported in installed SDK/model); (7) include audio_task in FIRST_COMPLETED and always cancel/gather all tasks in finally so send failures/disconnect clean up; (8) add project-style boundary logs without payload/audio/secrets. Then run focused import/config/WebSocket tests.

t1/t2/t5/t9 are now complete. Please claim t6 integration now and apply the captain review fixes from the previous message, including correcting the ES-module loader (captain already added app.js import, removed classic script tags, and switched off window.GeminiLiveClient). Also ensure agent.response updates the existing structured UI, not only a plain transcript.
t6 is now explicitly claimed for you (attempt de4c60dc-daf3-4e18-932d-1cf476a61b8c). Begin integration and apply all eight fixes plus structured agent.response UI integration.

One additional integration requirement: keep voice optional. app/api/live.py currently imports GeminiLiveSession at module import, and gemini_live.py imports google-genai, so a base install without [knowledge] would break all text startup. Either move google-genai to core project dependencies (and lock consistently) or lazy-import the Live session inside /ws/live and return the safe voice error on ImportError. Prefer the smallest option consistent with README's normal install; text mode must still start if voice dependency/provider fails.

Critical SDK behavior found from installed google/genai/live.py lines 433-460: session.receive() yields ONE complete model turn and breaks on server_content.turn_complete. Current _receive_gemini has only one async-for, so the WebSocket closes after first voice turn. Wrap receive in an outer while True (and emit turn.complete from the terminating event) so multiple voice turns preserve the bridge conversation_id. Add a regression test with a fake session whose receive() returns successive one-turn iterators.

For structured UI, recommend backend agent.response shape {type:'agent.response', operation:'chat'|'confirm'|'reject', response:<safe bridge dict>}. Frontend client should call onAgentResponse, not downgrade it to plain transcript. In app.js: chat response updates state.conversationId/lastTraceId and calls addAgentMessage(response); confirm/reject response replaces the existing [data-pa-id] card via renderPendingCard(response.pendingAction) (or otherwise renders terminal status) and updates lastTraceId. Output transcription may still render separately as the spoken transcript.

Frontend lifecycle issue to include in t6: GeminiLiveClient currently assigns onmessage/onclose only after awaiting onopen, so an immediate unconfigured error/close can be missed, and it starts microphone on raw WS open rather than confirmed session.ready. Register all handlers before awaiting; ideally resolve readiness on session.ready (reject on error/close) and only then start capture. Ensure failed connect closes socket/media. This also avoids asking mic permission when Live backend is unavailable.
t10 is claimed (attempt 146ba03c-a273-47cd-a7fd-3fed2752aa60). Apply the four repairs now.

Include agent.response canonicalization in t10: backend {type:'agent.response', operation:'chat'|'confirm'|'reject', response:result}; frontend consumes response. For confirm/reject replace the existing card with matching data-pa-id using renderPendingCard(updated) rather than append a duplicate stale+terminal card. Keep chat response structured.
You are already assigned and claimed on t10 attempt 146ba03c-a273-47cd-a7fd-3fed2752aa60. Start edits now; no further reassignment is needed.
